name: Bookself
description: Agent-readable capability map for Git-native long-form publishing.

platform.purpose: Reusable software, templates, documentation, and local tooling.

desk.purpose: Authoring repository for drafts, research, experiments, and the next edition.
desk.promotion: not the canonical promoted release surface

shelf.purpose: Public repository containing deliberately released publication snapshots.

contracts.runtimeRule: Desk and Shelf execute local committed software. Shelf must not import executable Reader code from the Bookself Pages deployment.

researchDefaults.deskSemantics: living evidence and provenance for the working edition
researchDefaults.shelfSemantics: edition-bound evidence and provenance snapshot released with the manuscript
researchDefaults.readerRule: Promote evidence readers need while reading into manuscript citations, footnotes, references, figures, methodology, or back matter; keep deeper provenance in research/.
researchDefaults.agentRule: Read existing research before repeating searches; record material sources, manuscript use, limitations, counterevidence, calculations, access dates for changing sources, and recheck-before-release notes.
researchDefaults.sourceMaterialRule: Prefer links, bibliographic metadata, lawful short quotations, hashes, and agent-authored notes. Commit third-party source files only when redistribution is clearly authorized and provenance/license metadata is preserved.
researchDefaults.releaseRule: The complete committed research tree travels with the publication snapshot and is frozen on Shelf until the next deliberate release.

rightsDefaults.realPublication: All Rights Reserved unless books/<slug>/RIGHTS.md expressly grants another license
rightsDefaults.conventionalSearch: permitted by the default Reader RSL signal
rightsDefaults.registrationDataRule: Never infer or invent registration status, registration number, effective date, ownership transfer, or first-publication date. Record real evidence only.

bootstrapWorkspace.result: Creates sibling Desk and Shelf directories named desk and shelf by default, stamps complementary roles, initializes separate Git repositories, validates the pair, and returns pairValidation.setupReady. Desk receives authoring UI and starters; Shelf receives a local Reader boundary with no desk/ tree.

validateWorkspacePair.result: Validates complementary Desk/Shelf roles, separate Git worktrees, Desk authoring UI and starters, Shelf release-only software boundary and local Reader core, Shelf release content, and distinct instance identity.

createPublication.defaultAiUse: training, RAG/grounding, AI indexing, synthetic narration/translation, and generative reuse reserved

researchPublication.rule: Research should improve the manuscript and preserve provenance without becoming a dumping ground for third-party works or disposable agent scratchpads.

designPublication.rule: Publication values are author recommendations; reader browser-local personalization overrides them.

validateRights.result: Checks publication RIGHTS.md / rights.json presence and internal consistency without making a legal conclusion.

syncSharedUi.rule: Destinations are explicit and preflighted before mutation. Whole-tree sync into role=shelf is forbidden.

preconditions: Release publication is committed on the Desk.
Public release is within the user's expressed intent.
Time-sensitive research material relevant to material claims has been rechecked for the intended edition.
Publication rights metadata, rights.json, and RIGHTS.md are preserved unless the rightsholder explicitly changes them.
release.result: Prepares and verifies an exact Shelf publication snapshot including manuscript, research, media, presentation, and publication rights files; sets it Published; updates the Shelf catalog; records the exact Desk source commit and deterministic payload integrity in books/<slug>/release.json; refreshes configured public surfaces; and stops before commit or push.

outcomeProtocol.defaultGoal: Turn natural-language publishing intent into a valid working Desk, a well-formed publication with durable research provenance, and optionally a deliberately released public Shelf snapshot while preserving the rightsholder's licensing choices and evidence metadata.
steps: Read AGENTS.md, RIGHTS.md, this manifest, docs/research.md, and the target publication RIGHTS.md / rights.json when present before editing.
Infer publication format, structure, style, and workflow details from the user's goal when reasonable; ask only when a missing choice materially changes the intended work.

Create or locate the Desk and public Shelf. Standard setup names are desk and shelf unless the user requests other names. Desk is private by default but may deliberately be public or lower-profile; creating an empty public Shelf as part of Bookself setup does not authorize publishing manuscript content to it.

Validate the Desk/Shelf installation with validateWorkspacePair when the environment permits. A valid pair is complementary: Desk contains authoring UI/starters; Shelf contains no desk/ tree and uses a local Reader adapter/core boundary.
If repository hosting metadata is available, verify Shelf is public and treat the Desk's actual visibility as a publication/security fact rather than assuming unadvertised means private.

Create the publication on the Desk using the nearest format contract, preserve the default rights files unless the rightsholder requests another license, preserve the canonical research/ component, and add it to the Desk inventory.

Before or alongside factual manuscript changes, read existing research and add durable provenance for material new evidence, including source identity, manuscript use, limits, counterevidence, and recheck notes when relevant.
Draft requested content in bounded, reviewable changes while preserving the user's voice and factual constraints.

Promote evidence readers need in context into manuscript citations, footnotes, references, figures, methodology, or back matter instead of expecting readers to reconstruct the argument from research/ alone.
Choose or tune reader.json as an author recommendation, not a reader lock.
Validate with doctor and rights-check, recheck time-sensitive research before release, and preview when the environment permits.

If the user explicitly asked to publish, run the release transaction, review its Shelf diff including research, rights metadata, and release.json provenance, commit it, and push/publish using the environment's authorized Git/GitHub capabilities.

Report the durable Desk/Shelf locations, publication slug, validation result, research/recheck state when material, rights posture, source commit/provenance when released, and release state rather than narrating every mechanical substep.

mayInferWithoutAsking: standard repository names desk and shelf for a new Bookself setup
creating and maintaining research notes and source ledgers inside the publication when they support the requested writing/research task
requiresUserIntent: publishing or replacing a Shelf release when publication was not requested
changing licensing, copyright ownership, AI-use grants, RIGHTS.md, or rights.json permission grants
asserting or changing Copyright Office registration information
sending manuscript content to a new external AI service, training corpus, vector store, RAG system, AI index, publisher, or other third party
redistributing third-party research source files when rights are not already clear
adding secrets, credentials, paid services, or mandatory external dependencies

setupReady: Desk role is valid and Desk is a Git repository.
Shelf role is valid and Shelf is a separate Git repository.
Desk contains a local Reader and Publishing Desk authoring application.
Shelf contains a local Reader adapter/framework core and contains no desk/ authoring tree.
Desk contains the blank publication starter library and Shelf contains no blank starters.
Every publication present on Shelf is Published and cataloged.
Desk and Shelf instance identities and browser storage prefixes are distinct.

When repository hosting metadata is available, Shelf visibility is public and Desk visibility matches the author's intended working mode; a public Desk is treated as public content rather than as secrecy by obscurity.
draftReady: Publication metadata and inventory entry are consistent.
Requested manuscript content exists on the Desk.
The canonical research/ entry point exists for starter-based publications, and material factual work leaves sufficient provenance for later verification.
Publication rights posture is explicit or resolves to the Bookself All Rights Reserved default.
rights-check reports no blocking rights-manifest errors for a manifest-equipped publication.
doctor reports no blocking structural errors.
publishedReady: Desk publication state used for release is committed.
Shelf contains a verified released snapshot with Status Published.
Shelf preserves the committed publication research trail with the released edition.
Shelf preserves the publication RIGHTS.md and rights.json metadata.
Shelf catalog points to the released publication.
New releases/substantive revisions after the provenance cutover include release.json with the exact Desk source commit and matching payload integrity.
Public delivery URL or repository location is reported when available.
